scan_summary.source: combined: real rca + 6 synthetic blind-test DBs (local, temporary)

investigations.title: [REAL] DISCOVERY (undocumented) #2: ctr ramp -7..-11% then floor -20% at publisher_tier=tier_3
investigations.uniformity: uniform -15..-30% across every sub-dimension inside tier_3; tier_1/tier_2 flat
investigations.mechanism: Tier-3 click degradation Jun 16-26: relative CTR (vs rest of slice) ramps -7% to -11% over Jun 16-21, holds a -20% floor Jun 22-26, recovers Jun 27. Revenue/eCPM/fill/render untouched. Hidden two ways: docs claim 'CTR flat globally' (tier_3 is only ~29% of impressions), and the 11-day span contaminates any all-days median baseline (MAD inflates, z peaks 3.0 < 3.5 gate) — needs iterative re-baselining. Verified from rca.cube.
investigations.confidence: high — clean floor 5-7x clean-day noise; shape = ramp + floor + recovery
ruled_out: tier_1 / tier_2 CTR: flat through the window
tier_3 eCPM 2.40-2.47 and revenue/day 144-150: unchanged
fill_rate / render_rate: flat -> not a funnel event

actions.text: Treat CTR as scannable per-segment - the 'CTR flat' doc claim only holds globally
Check tier_3 click tracking / SDK build for Jun 22-26 in a real-world analogue

investigations.title: [REAL] DISCOVERY (undocumented): ecpm +23.5% at ad_format=native × region=EU
investigations.uniformity: isolated to ad_format×region=ad_format=native × region=EU; sibling segments move within noise
investigations.mechanism: Revenue-neutral EU format swap Jun 16-20: interstitial eCPM 3.25->2.28 while native 2.34->2.93, rest-of-world flat. Not in the organizer answer key; verified from raw ad_events. ecpm at ad_format×region=ad_format=native × region=EU fell +23.5% while the rest of the slice held — a segment-local cause, not an upstream one.
ruled_out: ad_format=native (+7.2%): dilution — explained by ad_format=native × region=EU
